queries.name: left shoulder
queries.description: The left shoulder is the joint connecting the left arm and the torso, typically situated on the upper left side of the chest.

queries.name: right shoulder
queries.description: The right shoulder is the joint connecting the right arm and the torso, typically situated on the upper right side of the chest.

queries.name: left elbow
queries.description: The left elbow is the joint connecting the left upper arm and the left forearm, typically situated between the left shoulder and left wrist.

queries.name: right elbow
queries.description: The right elbow is the joint connecting the right upper arm and the right forearm, typically situated between the right shoulder and right wrist.

queries.name: left hip
queries.description: The left hip is the joint connecting the left thigh to the pelvis, typically located on the left side of the lower torso.

queries.name: right hip
queries.description: The right hip is the joint connecting the right thigh to the pelvis, typically located on the right side of the lower torso.

queries.name: left knee
queries.description: The left knee is the joint between the left thigh and left lower leg, located between the left hip and left ankle.

queries.name: right knee
queries.description: The right knee is the joint between the right thigh and right lower leg, located between the right hip and right ankle.

queries.name: pelvis
queries.description: The pelvis is the bony structure that forms the base of the spine and connects the torso to the lower body, typically located between the left hip and the right hip.

queries.name: neck
queries.description: The neck is the part of the body connecting the head to the torso, typically situated between the left and right shoulders.

queries.name: thorax
queries.description: The thorax is the central part of the upper torso, typically located below the neck and between the left and right shoulders.
